actions: Only provision the named isolated qualification resources, scoped IAM, test hostname/TLS and monitoring once reviewed; deploy fake-provider candidate only there.

Seed synthetic records, run scheduled off-host copy, isolate/fence primary, restore and measure; isolate/recover VM for alerts. One notification to one explicitly named test responder requires exact authorization.

Use isolated service-level and traffic limits, arm 24h shutdown before load, stop on unexpected resource/traffic, cost uncertainty or cap exhaustion. Budget alerts alone do not enforce the ceiling. Require resource limits/teardown and a verified path to stay under the ceiling or keep blocked.

Return admission to stopped, stop both qualification VMs and separately remove all named ephemeral resources only under explicit disposition approval. Retain the backup disk for seven days and require exact consent for permanent disposition; remove or extend before retention expiry. Verify final inventory and billing.
